prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished story-stage landscape illustration, without any title or lettering. Opaque wide 16:9 at the largest available landscape resolution, intended for downscaling to 640x360 and display at 360-480px width. Reference 1 is the game's painted pixel-art style anchor; reference 2 is its story painting style; reference 3 is this realm's palette, architecture and landmarks. All are reference inputs, not edit targets. Match the crisp visible painted pixel clusters and stepped silhouettes, rich but controlled colour, layered fantasy depth; no photographic or smooth 3D rendering. Cohesive nine-picture set rules: wide level establishing view, one dominant landmark centred horizontally in the MIDDLE THIRD, skyline/horizon around 70-74% image height in the LOWER THIRD, key environmental light from UPPER LEFT, midtone readability with dark blue-violet shadows, moderate saturation and contrast comparable to the other realms. Simple large shapes readable in a thumbnail. The outermost 3% on every side must be low-detail calm scenery safe for an 8px frame overlap, but DO NOT draw a frame. Keep the entire landmark in view. No people, human faces, humanoid figures, statues, letters, text-like decoration, glyphs, runes, numerals, logo, watermark, UI, borders or frames. No text anywhere. Stage 9, take A. YGGDRASIL HEART: the WORLD TREE with a GLOWING PINK HEART clearly nestled in its trunk ABOVE THE FINAL ARENA'S FLOATING PLATFORM. Take A: grand symmetric wide establishing view, broad purple leafy crown and ancient forked trunk centred, clearly heart-shaped hot-pink core at x50% y46%. A single broad round stone battle arena floats directly beneath at y72%, its rocky pointed underside visible; tree rises from the rear of that platform, empty front fighting surface readable. Low cloud-sea horizon at y74%, calm cosmic violet sky and a few tiny distant islands, NOT a busy nine-realm montage. Upper-left cool lavender starlight illuminates canopy and left trunk; pink heart only secondary local glow. Navy, deep purple, magenta and small restrained gold architectural accents matching realm reference. No writing, runic rings, sigils, faces in bark, statues, fighters, UI or frame. LAYOUT PRIORITY over the reference compositions: references supply style and realm identity only. Do NOT repeat their tall busy edge islands or high skyline. Keep the distant horizon unmistakably at y=75% of frame height, leaving the top 70% broad quiet atmospheric space interrupted only by the SINGLE central landmark. All secondary distant ground details remain below y=70%. No elaborate foreground objects at the edges. Main landmark base at y=76%, top near y=28%, visual centre x=50%. Calm outer 8 pixels after downscale.
